subject: plot item information curve for all items

messages.author: 9c015322ee9b676d
messages.subject: plot item information curve for all items
parts:
Hi all,

Using plot() method while setting type to "trace" will plot item characteristic curve for all items. Likewise, I'm wondering whether it's possible to plot item information curve for all items. 
Thank you!

Shensheng

messages.author: 71bfb5f1e96782a8
messages.subject: Re: plot item information curve for all items
parts: you can use iteminfo() and testinfo() functions to get the information and then plot it.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: plot item information curve for all items
parts:
See 

library(mirt)
method?plot("SingleGroupClass")

Or navigate to the plot-method helpfile via the R HTML documentation index. You want plot(mod, type = 'itemtrace')

Phil
